comment: Measured on 4 Nov 2026 on Linux: start about 2 s and 30.6 MB, first round +2.9 MB, second round +0.0 MB. Raise a limit only on purpose, in the same pull request as the change that needs it, saying why. 11 Nov 2026: the start limit went from 36 to 37 MB. Giving the small text sizes names (Styles/Sizes.axaml), so a style can change them, costs about 0.7 MB at start (35.8 to 36.5 MB): each of the sidebar's and Overview's small texts now follows its name instead of holding a typed number. Pages opened later cost no more than before.
